entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-09-15
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • DbContext pooling recycles a context whose ConcurrencyDetector is stuck in the critical section; every later rent fails with "A second operation was started on this context instance" #38983
    12.0-preview1
  • Named default constraint removal incorrectly targets temporal history table #38836
    12.0-preview1

Updated

  • Switch to using the new SqlClient user-agent feature #36571
    12.0.0
  • Working with JSON columns in SQLServer uses strict mode, could result in "SqlException: Property cannot be found on the specified JSON path" exception. #33565
    Backlog
  • Regression: Array column querying broken in EFC 11.0.0-rc.1.26425.128 #38993

PullRequests

Created

  • Emit `safe` keyword on generated UnsafeAccessor methods under updated memory safety rules #39001
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'release/11.0' #39000
  • [release/8.0]: Bump Microsoft.Azure.Cosmos from 3.37.1 to 3.63.0 #38999
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/8.0]: Bump Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore from 8.0.30 to 8.0.31 #38998
    area-infrastructure
  • Lift GroupBy aggregates through filtered principals as outer joins #38996
    community-contribution

Merged

  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38994
  • [release/11.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38997
  • Reset ConcurrencyDetector when a pooled context is returned #38995
    community-contribution
  • Do not carry a named default constraint onto the temporal history table #38875
    community-contribution, 12.0.0
  • Prefer milestones to labels in the labeling workflow #38991

Updated

  • Turn on Helix Job Monitor #38751
  • Format vector floats with the invariant culture in SqlServerVectorTyp… #38725
    community-contribution, 12.0.0
  • Efcore community fixes #38715
    community-contribution, 12.0.0
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #38992
  • [release/11.0] Allow unconstrained relationships to break SaveChanges command cycles #38989
  • Honor DOTNET_GLOBAL_INSTALL_DIR in activation scripts #38990
